preview.end.exited.defaultMessage: {known, select, yes {The dev server exited (code {code}).} other {The dev server exited.}}
preview.end.exited.description: The Preview tab's line: the dev server's process ended. known: yes when there is an exit code ({code}, a number): keep the select keys.

preview.end.guardStopped.description: The Preview tab's line: the Preview's network guard (the filtering proxy every request of the page goes through) stopped, so the page was closed.

preview.end.noFreePort.description: The Preview tab's line: every port of the Preview's range is in use. {first} and {last} are port numbers.

preview.end.noStart.description: The Preview tab's line. {detail} is why, in English as the log has it.

preview.end.notListening.defaultMessage: Nothing listened on port {port} within {seconds} s.
preview.end.notListening.description: The Preview tab's line: the dev server didn't start listening in time. {port} is a port number, {seconds} a number of seconds.

preview.end.otherPort.defaultMessage: The server listens on {ports}, not on {port}: pass the port it is given, such as --port %PORT%.
preview.end.otherPort.description: The Preview tab's line: the dev server ignored the port it was given (in PORT). {ports} lists the ports it listens on, {port} is the one it was given; --port %PORT% is a command-line example: keep it.

preview.end.placeEnded.defaultMessage: Stopped: its slot's lease or its review ended.
preview.end.placeEnded.description: The Preview tab's line: the place it ran in (a slot lent to a card, a review copy) was given back.

preview.end.placeHeld.defaultMessage: An earlier dev server here couldn't be ended, so nothing starts here until it is.
preview.end.placeHeld.description: The Preview tab's line: a previous server in this place couldn't be proved stopped.

preview.end.projectClosed.defaultMessage: Stopped: the project or its workspace closed.

preview.end.stopped.description: The Preview tab's line: the dev server was stopped.

preview.end.stranger.defaultMessage: Port {port} is held by another program (process {pid}), so its page isn't shown.
preview.end.stranger.description: The Preview tab's line: another program listens on the dev server's port. {port} and {pid} are numbers.

preview.end.turnedOff.defaultMessage: Stopped: the Preview was turned off.

preview.settings.address.defaultMessage: Each start gets a free port from {first}–{last} in {variable}. The server must listen on it on localhost: the page is then at {url}.
preview.settings.address.description: A line in Project Settings → Preview: where the dev server must listen. {first} and {last} are port numbers (the range), {variable} is PORT (an environment variable), {url} an address such as http://127.0.0.1:%PORT%/: keep the last two as they are.

preview.settings.badPath.defaultMessage: A page path starts with / and has no spaces or backslashes.
preview.settings.badPath.description: An error under the Page box (Project Settings → Preview): what was typed isn't a page path.

preview.settings.clear.description: A button (Project Settings → Preview): removes the project's preview command.

preview.settings.command.description: A field's label (Project Settings → Preview): the command line that starts the project's development server.

preview.settings.commandPlaceholder.description: The example in the empty Command box (Project Settings → Preview): a command line, keep it as it is.

preview.settings.failed.description: An error's title: saving Project Settings → Preview's values failed.

preview.settings.hmr.defaultMessage: A second port for hot reload
preview.settings.hmr.description: A switch's label (Project Settings → Preview): the server also gets a port of its own for its hot reload socket, in CW_PREVIEW_HMR_PORT.

preview.settings.hmrNote.defaultMessage: In {variable}, for a server whose hot reload socket listens apart.
preview.settings.hmrNote.description: Beside the switch "A second port for hot reload" (Project Settings → Preview). {variable} is CW_PREVIEW_HMR_PORT, an environment variable.

preview.settings.noSuggestion.defaultMessage: No dev, start or preview script in package.json to suggest.
preview.settings.noSuggestion.description: A line under the Command box (Project Settings → Preview): the project's package.json has none of these scripts (keep their names as they are), or there is no package.json.

preview.settings.path.description: A field's label (Project Settings → Preview): the path of the page to open on the server, such as / or /app.

preview.settings.save.description: A button (Project Settings → Preview): saves the preview's command, page and hot reload port.

preview.settings.saved.description: A notification: Project Settings → Preview's values were saved.

preview.settings.suggested.description: A line under the Command box (Project Settings → Preview): Combwork found a script in the project's package.json. {script} is its name (dev, start, preview), {line} its command line, {command} the command Combwork suggests (npm run dev): keep them as they are.

preview.settings.useIt.description: A button beside the suggested command (Project Settings → Preview): puts it in the Command box, unsaved until Save.

preview.tab.about.defaultMessage: The page runs in a guarded view of its own: it reaches only its own dev server and the internet over https, never this computer's other services or your network, and asks for no permissions. The dev server's command is yours and runs with your rights. Turn the Preview off in Settings → Advanced (Preview: run projects' dev servers).
preview.tab.about.description: The Preview tab's info tip: what the previewed page can and can't reach, and where to turn the Preview off. Settings → Advanced and the setting's title: use them as translated there.

preview.tab.devTools.description: A button's tooltip (the Preview tab): opens the browser's developer tools for the previewed page (yours only, never an agent's).

preview.tab.dismiss.description: A button's tooltip: closes the bar "The page tried to open …" (the Preview tab).

preview.tab.failed.defaultMessage: Couldn't do that in the Preview
preview.tab.failed.description: An error's title: a Preview tab action (start, stop, show, reload) failed.

preview.tab.hardReload.description: A button's tooltip (the Preview tab): reloads the previewed page, fetching everything again.

preview.tab.notStarted.defaultMessage: The dev server isn't running here. Start runs {command}.
preview.tab.notStarted.description: The Preview tab before a start. {command} is the project's preview command (a command line: keep it as it is).

preview.tab.openInBrowser.description: A button on the bar "The page tried to open …" (the Preview tab): opens that address in the user's own web browser.

preview.tab.openSettings.description: A button (the Preview tab, no command yet): opens that section. Project Settings → Preview: use its names as translated there.

preview.tab.place.description: The Preview tab's picker's label: where the previewed dev server runs (the project folder, a slot, a review copy).

preview.tab.projectFolder.description: A place in the Preview tab's picker: the project's own folder (not a slot or a review copy).

preview.tab.reload.description: A button (the Preview tab): reloads the previewed page.

preview.tab.restart.description: A button beside "stale" (the Preview tab): stops the dev server and starts it again from the place's files now.

preview.tab.setUp.defaultMessage: Set the command that runs this project's dev server in Project Settings → Preview, and the Preview tab shows its page here.
preview.tab.setUp.description: The Preview tab in a project with no preview command. Project Settings → Preview is a section: use its names as translated there.

preview.tab.setUpTitle.description: The Preview tab's heading in a project with no preview command yet.

preview.tab.stale.defaultMessage: stale: its files changed after it started
preview.tab.stale.description: Beside the Preview tab's stamp: the place's files changed after the dev server started, so the page may not show them. Keep it short.

preview.tab.start.description: A button (the Preview tab): starts the project's dev server in the chosen place.

preview.tab.starting.description: The Preview tab while the dev server starts. {port} is a port number.

preview.tab.startingNoPort.description: The Preview tab while the dev server starts, before it has a port.

preview.tab.stop.description: A button (the Preview tab): stops the dev server.

preview.tab.tried.description: A bar over the Preview tab's page: the page tried to leave its own address (a link, a script, a new window). Combwork didn't follow it. {url} is the address.
